question.text: Put-Call parity holds for which type of options?

explanation.text: The Logic: Put-call parity (C + PV(X) = P + S) holds only for European options on the same underlying, with the same expiration and strike. American options may be exercised earlier, which can break the strict parity relationship. The Trap: Parity is an arbitrage relationship that depends on European exercise; do not assume it generalises to American options just because they are on the same underlying. Note: Page 76 of the NISM Series-I workbook states that put-call parity holds only for European options with the same underlying, expiration and strike. Pages 88-90 confirm that exchange-traded currency options in the workbook are premium-style European calls and puts, and page 69 explains American options can be exercised earlier.
